title: Words Representing Walks
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D$, and form a graph whose vertices are pairs $(v,b)$ with $v$ a vertex of $G$ and $b	ext{ is a bit}$, joining $(v,b)$ to $(v',b')$ when some neighbor index $i$ satisfies $v'=	ext{nbr}(v,i)$ and $b'$ is the opposite bit. For every walk $p$ in this graph from $(x_1,x_2)$ to $(y_1,y_2)$, there is a word $w$ of neighbor indices of length equal to the length of $p$, whose walk in $G$ goes from $x_1$ to $y_1$, and $y_2$ is $x_2$ toggled if and only if the length of $p$ is odd.
hypotheses_covered: Regular multigraph G of degree D
